key_insight: StreamCacheVGGT replaces binary token eviction with a training-free, inference-time cache that (1) scores tokens using cross-layer, multi-view signals to reduce noisy decisions and (2) compresses retained tokens with a hybrid scheme so constant memory budgets preserve far more geometry information.
problem_solved: Enables stable, high-quality dense 3D reconstruction from long continuous video streams under a strict O(1) memory budget by avoiding destructive pure-eviction policies and noisy single-layer scoring.
method: Cross-layer robust scoring: aggregate signals across transformer layers and temporal views to rank tokens more reliably than localized, single-layer heuristics.

Hybrid cache compression: instead of deleting tokens, apply mix of lightweight compression (quantization, low-rank/projection, or token merging) and selective eviction to retain useful geometry cues within fixed memory.
Training-free streaming integration: operate at inference time with the existing Visual Geometry Transformer pipeline to deliver constant-memory streaming reconstructions without retraining.
impact: Makes continuous, real-time dense 3D reconstruction feasible on memory-limited systems (edge devices, robots) by improving reconstruction quality and temporal stability while respecting strict memory constraints. Practitioners can adopt the method as an inference-time upgrade for existing VGT-based pipelines.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: streaming video → VGT encoder → Cross-Layer Scoring → Hybrid Cache Compression → decoder, showing information flow and where compression/retention happens.
Before/after comparison: two reconstructions from long video input (pure-eviction vs StreamCacheVGGT) highlighting preserved fine geometry and temporal stability.
Scoring heatmap: visualization across transformer layers and time showing how cross-layer aggregation produces robust token importance scores versus noisy single-layer scores.
Memory vs quality chart: fixed-memory (O(1)) curve showing higher reconstruction accuracy / lower drift for StreamCacheVGGT compared to eviction baselines as stream length increases.
paper_title: StreamCacheVGGT: Streaming Visual Geometry Transformers with Robust Scoring and Hybrid Cache Compression
paper_authors: Xuanyi Liu, Deyi Ji, Chunan Yu, Qi Zhu, Xuanfu Li
